biography.value: Pyre Lords are the first Fire Elemental with genuine tactical awareness. A typical turn opens with Fire Breath when it has recharged, then one Burning Fist against a priority target and one Flame Bolt against anything trying to stay at range — three [Combat] actions working in concert, with the third carrying the Multiple Action Penalty. Flight lets them maintain Momentum Defense while repositioning between strikes. A Cooperative Pyre Lord follows combat instructions without requiring justification. A Friendly one will ask one question before acting — not to challenge the instruction, but to confirm it understood the shape of the task.

system.attacksNotes:
Burning Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 5), Reach: 10 ft

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 fire damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage; target gains Ignited condition.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 fire damage; target gains Burning condition; no save.

Flame Bolt [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 5 + Ranged Combat 4), Range: 60 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 13 fire damage (8 + 5 Dex); target gains Singed.
  • Margin 2: 13 fire damage, DR halved (round up); target gains Ignited.
  • Margin 3: 13 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Ignited; all creatures within 5 feet of target take 4 fire damage from splash.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Fire Breath (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: 30-foot cone. Each creature makes a Reflex save. Compare Agil 5 + Melee Combat 6 targeting vs. save successes.

  • Margin 1:: 12 fire damage (Half DR) + Singed.
  • Margin 2: 12 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Ignited.
  • Margin 3: 12 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Burning; no save.

Heat Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 5 feet take 5 fire damage (Half DR). Momentum Defense: While the Pyre Lord has moved at least half its fly speed this turn, ### Attacks against it add 1 to both attack dice.
